GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 3 Wide 6th 4 Lengths 800m 3 Wide 7th 4 Lengths home turn 3 Wide 6th Middle Of Track Straight weakened final 100m # wide/tired late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 900m was inconvenienced. Raced wide and without cover throughout the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Drifted Back 3rd last 3 Wide 6 Lengths 600m, worked to Middle Of Track on the corner but did not finish race off last 200m # did not finish off
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the 800m, when racing ungenerously, was hampered and taken wider. A post-race veterinary examination revealed the gelding to have bled from one nostril. Trainer was advised of the provisions under the rule.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok drifted well back 8 lengths. well back turn. ran on strongly in Straight # looking for longer
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began only fairly. Near the 600m was obliged to be checked to avoid the heels of another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Caught 3 Wide No Cover Just off speed 2 Lengths 800m, weakened in Straight # wide/weakened
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, with its head up. Raced keenly in the early stages. Raced wide and without cover throughout.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began fairly. Not pushed early & raced behind Mid Field 3 Wide (4L from lead). Stayed same until pushed out Six Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Pressured 8W @ 300m & worked home fairly without threatening in last 200m. # Fair for further.
Jumped Ok , sat 3 Wide With Cover behind speed 2 Lengths 600m, peeled widest soon after Straightening Up , Kept Coming under riding final stages and got very close on line # got close late

Slow Out . Not pushed early & raced Mid Field 3 Wide No Cover (3.5L from lead). Worked to hold ground midrace & pushed to quicken Six Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Pressured Six Wide @ 250m & weakened in straight. Vetted clear. # Wide/never likely.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Passing the 500m began to lay out causing to race very wide.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , drove Through to be 2nd Two Wide 2 Lengths 600m, Hard Ridden when Leader sprinted away soon after Straightening Up , weakened last 200m # on pace/peaked 200m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Knuckled on jumping, shifted outwards and bumped another rnr.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Debut for stable. Slow away. Pushed to recover & raced behind leaders Two Wide (2L from lead). Tracked leaders Two Wide until pushed to quicken Four Wide (1L from lead) on home turn. Pushed along Six Wide @ 250m & pressured @ 200m. Challenged leaders @ 100m & laid in but did best late. Raced without tongue tie. # Had perfect run.
